subject: general
question: Who among the following was the oldest at the time of taking the oath of Prime minster for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Morarji Desai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Morarji Ranchhodji Desai** was an Indian independence activist and politician who served as the 4th Prime Minister of India between 1977 to 1979 leading the government formed by the Janata Party.
 
• He is the **oldest person to hold the office of prime minister, at the age of 81, in the history of Indian politics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chaudhary Charan Singh served as the 5th Prime Minister **of India. Historians and people alike frequently refer to him as the 'champion of India's peasants.
 
• **V. P. Singh, was an Indian politician who was the 7th Prime Minister of India from 1989 to 1990 and the 41st Raja Bahadur of Manda.** He is India's only prime minister to have been former royalty. He brought, Land Holding Act 1960 which was aimed at lowering the ceiling on land holdings to make it uniform throughout the State.
 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee was an Indian politician and diplomat who served three terms as the 10th prime minister of India, f**irst for a term of 13 days in 1996, then for a period of 13 months from 1998 to 1999, followed by a full term from 1999 to 2004.
